note: Toolbar and dialog action buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for editor commands and settings (e.g., New, Open, Save, Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Find, Replace, Print, Help, OK, Cancel, Apply)
Toolbar and dialog toggle buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for view modes and options (e.g., Show Line Numbers, Show Right Margin, Fullscreen, Word Wrap)
Dialog checkboxes -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for configuration options (e.g., Highlight Current Line, Auto Indent, Use Default Font)
Dialog radio buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for mutually exclusive settings (e.g., Tab size, Indentation type, Line ending)
Dialog and toolbar labels -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for field descriptions, section headers, and status indicators (e.g., 'Encoding', 'Line Ending', 'Font', 'Search:', 'Replace:')
